mapper.insert: INSERT INTO layer_health (layer, day, state, failed_runs, yield, median, miss_share) VALUES (#{o.layer}, #{o.day}, #{o.state}, #{o.failedRuns}, #{o.yield}, #{o.median}, #{o.missShare}) ON CONFLICT (layer, day) DO UPDATE SET state = EXCLUDED.state, failed_runs = EXCLUDED.failed_runs, yield = EXCLUDED.yield, median = EXCLUDED.median, miss_share = EXCLUDED.miss_share
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM layer_health WHERE day > current_date - #{days}::int ORDER BY layer, day DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_layer_coverage (source_id, layer, sightings_28d, misses) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{layer}, #{sightings28d}, #{misses}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, layer) DO UPDATE SET sightings_28d = EXCLUDED.sightings_28d, misses = EXCLUDED.misses, updated = now()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM layer_health WHERE layer = #{layer} AND day = #{day}
SELECT coalesce(avg(miss_share), 0)::float8 FROM layer_health WHERE layer = #{layer} AND day >= #{day}::date - #{days}::int AND day < #{day}::date

SELECT (started AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'FAILED')::int AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'DEFERRED')::int AS deferred, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'DONE')::int AS done FROM harvest_run WHERE adapter = #{adapter} AND started >= (#{from}::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND started < ((#{to}::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (first_seen AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, count(*)::int AS n FROM work_sighting WHERE layer = #{layer} AND first_seen >= (#{from}::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND first_seen < ((#{to}::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT w.source_id, count(*)::int AS n FROM work_sighting ws JOIN work w ON w.id = ws.work_id WHERE ws.layer = #{layer} AND w.source_id IS NOT NULL AND ws.first_seen >= (#{from}::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND ws.first_seen < ((#{to}::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' GROUP BY w.source_id

WITH served AS (
SELECT id AS source_id FROM source WHERE active AND tier IN ('CORE','BROAD') AND onboarded_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM source_route WHERE layer = #{routeLayer} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
), cand AS ( SELECT DISTINCT work_id FROM work_sighting WHERE layer IN #{l} AND first_seen >= (#{from}::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND first_seen < ((#{to}::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ) SELECT w.source_id, count(*)::int AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_sighting m WHERE m.work_id = c.work_id AND m.layer = #{layer}))::int AS misses FROM cand c JOIN work w ON w.id = c.work_id JOIN served s ON s.source_id = w.source_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_sighting e WHERE e.work_id = c.work_id AND e.first_seen < (#{from}::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') GROUP BY w.source_id
